## Why This Is Asked

- CRDT/OT vs. last-writer-wins approaches

- How would you automatically detect diverging histories and validate merges after multiple concurrent editors?
- What latency, error-rate, and SLA metrics would you collect to prove end-to-end reliability?

- Idempotent handling of duplicate events

- Cross‑device (desktop/mobile) accessibility checks

